svg.title: Selected Clariceptify R1 conceptualization view
svg.desc: Thirteen distinct classes and fourteen selected plain associations in three explanatory panels. Repeated classes have the same registry identity. All other classes, generalizations, associations and textual constraints are omitted from this selected view.
